articles.title: Trump says victory over Iran 'at hand', stress that Tehran will 'never have a nuclear weapon'
articles.summary:
Trump says victory over Iran 'at hand', stress that Tehran will 'never have a nuclear weapon'

US President Donald Trump said that Washington will be victorious over Iran "whenever" he wants it to happen. 

"We have victory at hand (in Iran). It's going to be whenever, sort of, whatever I want it to be. To be honest, and we're trying to be nice, we're giving them every chance to make a deal and save a lot of lives. But I am not sure if they are going to take advantage of that," he said during Thanksgiving calls with US service members.

Trump also praised US forces for their role in the war on Iran, adding that they would never allow Tehran to have nuclear arms. 

"Each of you is playing an essential role to protect not only our country today but future generations of Americans by ensuring that Iran will never have a nuclear weapon. They will never have a nuclear weapon. That I can tell you."

articles.title: South Korea assures Iran that it has no plans of participating in the war
articles.summary:
South Korea assures Iran that it has no plans of participating in the war

During a phone call, South Korean Foreign Minister Cho Hyun assured Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi that Seoul has "no intention of intervening in or participating in the war".

The two exchanged views on their bilateral relations and the situation in the Middle East, discussing recent diplomatic efforts and initiatives to maintain peace and stability in the region.

According to a post on X by the Iranian Embassy in Seoul, Araghchi expressed concern regarding the "presence of any foreign military forces in the region, stressing that rather than contributing to peace and security, such a presence would heighten tensions and expand the scope of the conflict".

"Foreign Minister Cho reaffirmed South Korea’s support for peace and stability in the region, assuring Foreign Minister Araghchi that South Korea has no intention of intervening in or participating in the war and no plans to deploy troops to the region," the post added.

articles.title: Yemen war: How do the rival alliances and armed factions stack up?
articles.summary:
Yemen war: How do the rival alliances and armed factions stack up?

Yemen, where civil war broke out in 2014, has recently been rocked by the worst fighting in years. A truce agreed in 2022 between the Ansar Allah, better known as the Houthis, who control the north, and forces loyal to the government in the south disintegrated when Saudi Arabia bombed Sanaa airport in July.

In August and September, the Houthis mounted a quick offensive, recapturing much of the western coast, including the port of Mocha, putting it within close range of ships passing the strategically important Bab el-Mandab strait. 

The Houthis are now targeting Aden, Yemen’s second city and seat of its internationally recognised government since the group took the capital Sanaa 12 years ago.

Meanwhile, the Houthis have tightened their decade-long siege of Taiz, blocking the road to Aden and raising the prospect of its capture.

The Saudi-backed pro-government military coalition contains a variety of armed units and local militias, each with different goals, rival leaders and origins, leading to infighting and disorganisation.

Allegiances frequently shift and evolve: the Giants Brigade and the National Resistance Forces were each previously backed by the UAE. The leaders of both, like much of the coalition, are now bankrolled by Riyadh amid its fallout with Abu Dhabi. 

With fighting spread across multiple front lines, here’s an overview of the most important military and political parties involved in the conflict.

Read more: How do the rival alliances and armed factions in Yemen stack up?

articles.title: Several countries slam suspected Iranian attack on Kuwait
articles.summary:
Several countries slam suspected Iranian attack on Kuwait

A number of countries and their officials have condemned the latest drone attacks launched against Kuwait, which killed two Italian nationals. 

The UK minister Stephen Doughty condemned the attack as "utterly unacceptable" and said that his country "stands firmly with Kuwait, Italy and all those affected, without making mention of who could be behind the attacks.

The Syrian Foreign Ministry slammed Iran for the strikes, and affirmed its "full solidarity" with Kuwait. It also extended its condolences to the families of those killed.

Similarly, Saudi Arabia has also pinned the attacks on Iran, saying: "The continued Iranian attacks further exacerbate tensions and undermine stability."

Iran has denied the allegations that it launched the drones on Kuwait, with Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi calling the incident "suspicious".

archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, further incidents in the Strait of Hormuz are expected to maintain a high risk premium in maritime transport. Crude oil will continue to oscillate between oversupply concerns and geopolitical shocks.

archive.security_status_cs: Bezpečnostní situace v oblasti Blízkého východu a Rudého moře zůstává vysoce nestabilní kvůli probíhajícím útokům na tankery a regionální eskalaci konfliktů. Húsíové nadále využívají terminál Ras Issa pro dodávky paliva, zatímco námořní doprava čelí přímému ohrožení v Hormuzském průlivu.
archive.security_status_en: The security situation in the Middle East and Red Sea remains highly volatile due to ongoing tanker attacks and regional conflict escalation. The Houthis continue to utilize the Ras Issa terminal for fuel deliveries, while maritime shipping faces direct threats in the Strait of Hormuz.
archive.forecast_cs: V následujících dnech lze očekávat pokračující eskalaci útoků v oblasti Perského zálivu a Hormuzského průlivu, což udrží zvýšenou rizikovou prémii v námořní dopravě. Ropa bude i nadále vykazovat volatilitu mezi obavami z přebytku nabídky a hrozbami vojenských střetů.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, continued escalation of attacks in the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz is expected, maintaining an elevated risk premium in maritime transport. Crude oil will continue to exhibit volatility between supply surplus fears and military clash threats.

archive.security_status_cs: Situace v oblasti Perského zálivu a Hormuzského průlivu eskaluje po zprávách o útocích na ropné tankery pomocí námořních min. Spojené státy zároveň čelí širší vlně íránských kybernetických útoků a zavádějí nové sankce proti finančním sítím íránského námořního obchodu.
archive.security_status_en: The security situation in the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz is escalating following reports of oil tankers being hit by naval mines. Simultaneously, the United States is investigating a wider wave of Iranian cyberattacks and imposing fresh sanctions against financial networks supporting Iran's maritime trade.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat zvýšenou volatilitu cen ropy a přetrvávající napětí v Hormuzském průlivu kvůli hrozbám odvetných opatření ze strany Íránu.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, heightened oil price volatility and persistent tension in the Strait of Hormuz are expected due to threats of retaliation from Iran.

archive.security_status_cs: Situace v oblasti Hormuzského průlivu a Rudého moře nadále eskaluje, když íránské síly rozšiřují útoky na ropné tankery a vlečné lodě pomocí námořních min a dronů. Současně probíhají útoky saúdskoarabské koalice na jemenské přístavy jako Hodeidah, což prohlubuje regionální nestabilitu a ohrožuje klíčové námořní tepny.
archive.security_status_en: The situation in the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea continues to escalate as Iranian forces expand attacks on oil tankers and tugboats using naval mines and drones. Simultaneously, Saudi-led coalition strikes on Yemeni ports such as Hodeidah deepen regional instability and threaten critical maritime chokepoints.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující útoky v oblasti Hormuzského průlivu a Rudého moře, což udrží vysokou volatilitu cen energií a námořní přepravy. Trhy budou citlivě reagovat na jakékoliv zprávy o vojenské odvetě.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, continued attacks in the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea are expected, keeping energy prices and shipping volatility high. Markets will remain sensitive to any news regarding military retaliation.

archive.security_status_cs: Bezpečnostní situace v regionu se dramaticky vyhrotila po útoku Houthiů na saúdské ropné rafinerie a zprávách o úderech na tankery v Hormuzském průlivu. Konflikt se nadále šíří, doprovázen raketovými útoky v Saúdské Arábii a eskalací bojů v Jemenu.
archive.security_status_en: The security situation in the region has escalated dramatically following Houthi attacks on Saudi oil refineries and reports of strikes on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz. The conflict continues to spread, accompanied by missile strikes in Saudi Arabia and escalating fighting in Yemen.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat extrémní volatilitu cen ropy a komodit v důsledku přímých útoků na energetickou infrastrukturu, přičemž trhy budou extrémně citlivě reagovat na jakékoliv náznaky vojenské odvety.
archive.forecast_en: Extreme volatility in oil and commodity prices is expected over the coming days due to direct attacks on energy infrastructure, with markets remaining highly sensitive to any signs of military retaliation.

archive.security_status_cs: Bezpečnostní situace v oblasti Hormuzského průlivu a Rudého moře se prudce vyhrotila po útocích na energetickou infrastrukturu a tankery, včetně výbuchu LNG nosiče po nástraze miny. Hrozba přímých vojenských střetů a eskalace ze strany Íránu a jeho zmocněnců dramaticky zvyšuje riziko pro globální námořní obchod.
archive.security_status_en: The security situation in the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea has sharply escalated following attacks on energy infrastructure and tankers, including an LNG carrier explosion after hitting a naval mine. The threat of direct military clashes and escalation by Iran and its proxies drastically increases risks for global maritime trade.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující volatilitu cen komodit a ropy v důsledku incidentů v Hormuzském průlivu. Trhy budou vysoce citlivé na jakékoliv zprávy o možných vojenských odvetných opatřeních.
archive.forecast_en: Continued volatility in commodity and oil prices is expected over the coming days due to incidents in the Strait of Hormuz. Markets will remain highly sensitive to any news regarding potential military retaliatory measures.

archive.security_status_cs: Situace v Rudém moři a přilehlých klíčových koridorech, jako je Hormuzský průliv, zůstává vysoce nestabilní kvůli přetrvávajícím útokům na tankery a eskalaci napětí kolem Íránu. Zprávy UNCTAD potvrzují, že globální námořní obchod čelí zásadním poruchám a stagnaci, které prohlubují geopolitická rizika.
archive.security_status_en: The situation in the Red Sea and surrounding key corridors like the Strait of Hormuz remains highly volatile due to ongoing tanker attacks and escalating tensions involving Iran. UNCTAD reports confirm that global maritime trade faces major disruptions and stagnation, exacerbating geopolitical risks.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat přetrvávající vysokou volatilitu cen ropy a komodit kvůli napětí kolem Hormuzského průlivu. Trhy budou nadále citlivě reagovat na jakékoliv zprávy o vojenských akcích.
archive.forecast_en: Continued high volatility in oil and commodity prices is expected over the coming days due to tensions around the Strait of Hormuz. Markets will remain sensitive to any news regarding military actions.
